inspection_method: manual inspection of every native PNG after the single authorized first capture pass
renderer: Godot 4.7.2 stable official; macOS display; Forward+; Metal; Apple M1 Pro (Apple7)

images.finding: warm-ivory field is clean and neutral; surface variation is deliberately subtle; B1-BAND remains visible low in frame and must not be mistaken for field content
full 40 m field span is visible with no obvious finite material repeat; six modules are scale exemplars, not a placement schedule
complete wing motif is centered and readable; a pavilion sliver at far right is a proof-lineup framing artifact
complete central motif is centered and readable; neighboring family fragments remain at the side margins
complete pavilion group, multipane subdivisions and shallow pilaster strips are readable at full height; smaller motifs provide scale context only
complete base opening is isolated and readable; opaque face intentionally leaves window-versus-vent semantics unresolved
complete blue door and frame are readable; base-opening fragment at left is a proof-lineup framing artifact
band core, both finished terminals and shallow relief are readable; door appears as ordinary scale context
all six families remain legible in oblique depth context; flat lineup is explicitly illustrative and not an elevation
all families remain distinguishable at ordinary-distance scale; composition must not be read as count, cadence or receiver sequence
changed light exposes matte response, shallow depth and opaque component behavior; darker exposure still preserves all family silhouettes

blocked_review_claims: exact receiver placement or elevation composition
surveyed scale, count, cadence or sequence
correctness of unobserved east/rear, inner ring, tower, canopy or emblems
